cases.source: <?php namespace App; use Runa\Modules\Auth\Contracts\AuthProfiles; use Runa\Modules\Auth\Contracts\ProfileChange; use Runa\Support\Modules\Api\ModuleApis; function profile(ModuleApis $apis, string $id, int $version): void { $apis->resolve('runa.auth', AuthProfiles::class, '2.0.0')->edit($id, $version, new ProfileChange(name: 'Example')); }

<?php namespace App; use Runa\Modules\Permissions\Contracts\PermissionsAccess; use Runa\Modules\Permissions\Contracts\AssignmentPreview; function apply(PermissionsAccess $access, AssignmentPreview $reviewed): array { return $access->applyAssignments($reviewed); }
<?php namespace App; use Runa\Modules\Audit\Contracts\AuditReads; use Runa\Modules\Audit\Contracts\AuditQuery; function history(AuditReads $reads, AuditQuery $query): void { $reads->page($query); }

<?php namespace App; use Runa\Modules\Admin\Contracts\AdminAccess; use Runa\Support\Modules\Api\ModuleApis; function admin(ModuleApis $apis): array { return $apis->resolve('runa.admin', AdminAccess::class, '1.0.0')->bootstrap(); }

<?php namespace App; use Runa\Contracts\Modules\TransactionalMutation; use Runa\Contracts\Modules\MutationDefinition; use Runa\Contracts\Modules\MutationAccess; use Runa\Contracts\Modules\MutationProof; use Runa\Support\Modules\Data\ModuleTransactions; function commit(ModuleTransactions $transactions, TransactionalMutation $mutation): array { return $transactions->run([$mutation]); }

<?php namespace App; use Runa\Contracts\Modules\ManagementPageProvider; use Runa\Contracts\Modules\ManagementHandler; use Runa\Contracts\Modules\ManagementPage; use Runa\Contracts\Modules\ManagementRead; use Runa\Modules\Admin\Contracts\AdminRegistry; function register(AdminRegistry $registry, ManagementPageProvider $provider): void { $registry->register($provider); }

<?php namespace App; use Runa\Modules\Auth\Contracts\AuthAdministration; use Runa\Modules\Auth\Contracts\UserDirectoryQuery; use Runa\Support\Modules\Api\ModuleApis; function directory(ModuleApis $apis): void { $api = $apis->resolve('runa.auth', AuthAdministration::class, '1.0.0'); $api->users(new UserDirectoryQuery(limit: 25, search: 'Example')); }

<?php namespace App; use Runa\Modules\Admin\Contracts\AdminOperations; use Runa\Support\Modules\Api\ModuleApis; function diagnostics(ModuleApis $apis): array { return $apis->resolve('runa.admin', AdminOperations::class, '1.0.0')->read('diagnostics'); }
